title: A use-after-free caused by lack of lifecycle management when adding / removing XInput master devices in X.org X Server…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in X.org X Server before version 21.1.25 and XWayland before version 24.1.14 due to improper lifecycle management when adding or removing XInput master devices. Authenticated X clients could exploit this flaw to crash the X server, causing denial of service, or potentially execute code within the X server context.
